description: Body Interact™ is a computer- and interactive-table-based virtual patient simulation platform developed for health-professions education, enabling learners to conduct simulated clinical encounters and make treatment decisions.
title: Body Interact™ Virtual Patient Simulator

description: A Bodyswaps virtual-reality or desktop learning module developed with the Royal Society of Medicine and Professor Dame Lesley Fallowfield to train medical learners in de-escalating difficult conversations with patients and relatives.
title: Bodyswaps 'Navigating Angry Conversations' virtual learning module

description: A child-completed picture-book familiarity assessment developed by Davidse et al.
title: Book-cover recognition test

description: BookNook is a provider-run virtual, synchronous high-dosage reading tutoring programme for K–8 students, using a science-of-reading curriculum focused on phonological awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension.
title: BookNook

description: A Booktrust reading-for-pleasure and transition programme that provides personalised book packs and volunteer-led summer activities for pupils moving from primary to secondary school.
title: Booktrust Summer Active Reading Programme

description: BOPPPS is a goal-oriented, student-centered teaching framework organized around bridge-in, objectives, pre-assessment, participatory learning, post-assessment, and summary, used by educators to structure lessons and courses.
title: BOPPPS six-step teaching model

description: A 60-item confrontation-naming assessment developed by Kaplan, Goodglass, and Weintraub that measures expressive vocabulary by asking examinees to name increasingly difficult line drawings, with stimulus and phonemic cues after errors.
title: Boston Naming Test (BNT)

description: A degree-granting liberal arts higher-education programme run by Boston University in Massachusetts correctional facilities for incarcerated adults, funded through university scholarships and leading to a Bachelor of Liberal Arts degree.
title: Boston University Prison Education Program

description: Bottom Line is an intensive advising programme run by Bottom Line that supports primarily low-income, first-generation students with college applications, financial aid, college choice, and postsecondary persistence.
title: Bottom Line

description: A branded, multi-year college-access and persistence advising program developed and operated by the nonprofit Bottom Line for low-income and first-generation students.
title: Bottom Line College Advising Program
